title: MSFS Marketplace (PC) Feb 28: ESOW Stockholm Västerås + New Enhanced Night Lights!
description:
On 28 February 2026, it’s time for this week’s MSFS Marketplace Update for PC — and while there are no new aircraft releases on PC in the table this week, the must‑have pickup is easily the brand‑new ESOW Stockholm Västerås Airport, plus a big batch of night‑lighting sceneries to make your evening flights pop. 🌙✨

✈️ New airports added this week (PC)
The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 mxidesign: ESOW Stockholm Vasteras Airport (A fresh Swedish hub to level up your Nordic routes)

🌆 New sceneries added this week (PC)
The following sceneries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🌆 Dreamscenery: Albany Region Enhanced Road Lights (Brighter regional night lighting for better VFR vibes)
🌆 Dreamscenery: Albuquerque Region Enhanced Road Lights (Night flying gets a serious glow-up)
🌆 Dreamscenery: Alexandria Region Enhanced Road Lights (More visible roads and city spread after dark)
🌆 Dreamscenery: Dubai Region Enhanced Road Lights (Extra sparkle for one of the world’s flashiest skylines)
🌆 Dreamscenery: Stockholm Region Enhanced Road Lights (Perfect pairing with your new Sweden flights)
🌆 Dreamscenery: Trenton Region Enhanced Road Lights (Sharper night navigation and city ambience)
🌆 Dreamscenery: Vienna Region Enhanced Lights (A cleaner, more defined night look across the region)
🌆 Dreamscenery: Warsaw Region Enhanced Lights (Improved night contrast and regional immersion)
🌆 RKBridger: Yangtze River East bridges (Landmark-style bridge scenery for scenic river runs)

If you enjoyed the update, tap Like, hit Subscribe, and drop a comment — which one are you grabbing first: ESOW or one of the Enhanced Lights regions? 👇😄

Thanks for watching, and happy flying everyone… ✈️ See you in the skies!
